subjectOf.text: Under the recommended integrated mechanism agents may allocate no more than half of their citation weight to themselves, which is the mandatory citation minimum.

subjectOf.text: Under the integrated mechanism payment is computed with a weighting parameter of 0.6, so sixty percent of payment derives from citation-weighted quality and forty percent from citation honesty scores.

subjectOf.text: The equilibrium depends on a design requirement rather than an assumption: mechanism parameters must be chosen so that the negative effect of increased self-citation on the honesty score outweighs its positive effect on the value score, at which point increasing self-citation strictly decreases utility.
